It need not commute with reconstructed H0. This preserves the earlier equilibrium target without claiming that it has been attained.

explicit_family.status: PROPOSED parameterized family, not instantiated material state and not a new equilibrium theorem
explicit_family.representation: For each admitted spin/k raw frame Psi_s with Gram S_s, use the already defined symmetric-coordinate map Q_s=Psi_s S_s^(-1/2), without changing the stored Psi. Explicitly authorize a preparation one-body operator a_s in that Q frame. The minimal saved-label candidate sets a_s to the diagonal saved energy labels only as a declared preparation model, NOT as the reconstructed full-PW H0.
explicit_family.zero_temperature_rule: Define the family by a declared FD limit F_s=lim_{theta->0+} [I+exp((a_s-mu_s(theta)I)/theta)]^(-1), with multipliers enforcing the chosen weighted mean-number and, if selected, mean-M constraints. Theta is a limiting parameter, not MV degauss or a selected experimental temperature. Below/above the limiting Fermi block the family has filled/empty populations; fractional boundary populations and their limit path must be explicit. At an exact unsplit degenerate block in this Gibbs-limit candidate, occupation is scalar on the block; do not impose one-half by fiat or select a band-label subset without a different preparation authority.
explicit_family.raw_coefficients: Reuse coefficients_from_orthonormal_populations for the diagonal saved-label candidate: D_s=S_s^(-1/2) F_s S_s^(-1/2), then existing FactorPreparation. General block/unitary populations must transport the density consistently; they are not implemented by pretending arbitrary nonorthogonal D entries are probabilities.
explicit_family.number_and_spin_constraints: Proposed per-cell ledger N=sum_s w_s Tr(S_s D_s), with explicit spin-resolved contributions and M=sum_s sign(spin_s) w_s Tr(S_s D_s) if that longitudinal spin-number difference is constrained. No extra blanket spin factor. An IBZ weight is a quadrature/multiplicity, not an occupation probability. A future uniform BvK representation records the corresponding cell factor separately.
explicit_family.no_stationarity_inference: This family is zero-T with respect to its declared preparation operator/limiting construction. It is not shown to be the full-H0 ground state, self-consistent at nbar, stationary under H0+K delta_n, or a coupled electron-ion equilibrium. Raw saved eigenpairs precede the output-density potential rebuild. Retain initial electronic drift and ionic acceleration whenever the declared mean model yields them.
explicit_family.degenerate_covariance: Retain the full degenerate/population sector in the quasifree ordered contractions, including off-diagonal probes within a degenerate block. Fixed mean N is not exact canonical N; fractional limiting populations can carry number fluctuations. No relaxation rate follows.
explicit_family.complement_limit: Exactly empty complement is an explicit prepared-state family choice. Without its energies/completeness, it is not a proof that the unretained full-PW modes lie above the physical Fermi level. No projected saved-band dynamics is licensed.

source_trace.meaning: Uses saved total valence density rho(:,1), FFT to G, local radial vloc, phases and cell/reciprocal normalization. Gamma-packed storage factor is conditional on gamma_only, not on the k point being Gamma. Actual saved storage is full complex.

Loops explicit k/spin and bands with wg; constructs projector and derivative overlaps, includes two-sided derivative via its real contraction, sums pools, calls augmentation and internally symmetrizes because only the IBZ was summed. For this ordinary NC model the augmented overlap term vanishes by model contract; addusforce_g returns when okvan is false. Reuse both projector sides in the existing NC action, not a local-only force or screened derivative.

XML occupations are wg/wk, so historical numerical contraction weights are wk times the untouched XML values. They may be used as numerical-reference coefficients, never automatically as Pauli probabilities or Wick-state occupations.

Periodic Ewald uses actual UPF valence charges, geometry/cell and reciprocal conventions. Other branches include ESM, dispersion, fields, MT and solvation. Actual input is the ordinary periodic PBE NC case with no explicit external-force/field card; a reproduction ledger still records enabled branches rather than assigning absent terms from the XML total.

vnew is V_HXC(out)-V_HXC(in). force_corr uses its spin average in the collinear case and the derivative of a superposition of atomic charge tables. It is not the bare local/nonlocal force, nor a physical preparation force. Output-density H0 reconstruction does not recover V(in) from saved eigenvalue labels. The existing log contains the resulting correction at print precision; full vnew was not found in the supplied save contract.

Sums component arrays and applicable optional terms, then subtracts the net force per atom subject to ESM/gate/QMMM branches. This is a processing operation, not evidence that an arbitrary prepared state has zero mean acceleration.

source_trace.stage: External fields, symmetry, torque and external force
source_trace.meaning: Applies nextffield force fields, symvector, optional remove_tot_torque, then extfor when textfor and plugin external contributions. Symvector averages rotations together with atom permutations. A symmetry-breaking preparation cannot be processed this way unless that projection/constraint belongs to its specified model.

Prints total in Ry/bohr, then masks force and forcescc with if_pos, prints components at finite precision, and XML serializes module force divided by e2 in Hartree units. XML is processed output, not a component archive.

constructive_candidates.joint_local_scalar: PROPOSED, UNVERIFIED composition: E_loc = sum_s w_s Tr(H0_s rho_s) + (1/2)<n-nbar,Kbar(n-nbar)> + u dot (G[rho]+ell_II) + (1/2)u dot Cbar u + kinetic_ions, with all densities/means covering the declared system or an explicitly supplied remainder. constructive_candidates.offset_relation: If a consumer retains the old pair of offsets, construct a numerical Gbar from one explicitly specified reference expectation and DEFINE Fbar=F_II-Gbar under the same scalar. Then the existing Fbar-(G-Gbar) form is a proposed alternate representation of F_II-G, to be checked independently. This is not choosing Gbar=0, setting Fbar to processed XML, or fitting a cancellation to suppress drift. Cleaner implementation stores the single physical ionic coefficient, avoiding redundant independently supplied offsets.
constructive_candidates.curvature_rule: Keep Cbar as the accepted fixed joint-second-order coefficient, which already contains ionic and reference frozen-electron second derivatives. Insert only the ion-ion linear term here. Do not add the full U_II(Rbar+u) on top of Cbar without repartitioning its quadratic ionic contribution; that would double count. Do not infer a new W-dependent curvature from g archives.
